description: This Java class represents an event called 'PolicyIdCreated' which is emitted after a Thing's policyId has been created. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, accessing the policyId, and serializing the event to JSON. The class extends a base event class and implements interfaces for Thing modification events.

classes.name: PolicyIdCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class representing the creation of a policy ID for a Thing. Provides mechanisms for serialization/deserialization from JSON, accessors for policyId, and methods for creating modified copies of the event.

methods.name: PolicyIdCreated.of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new PolicyIdCreated event instance with detailed parameters including thing ID, policy ID, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: PolicyIdCreated.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a PolicyIdCreated instance, given headers.

methods.name: getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
